## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the change, motivation, and context.

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or endpoint
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `ci`: CI/CD pipeline enhancement
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation improvement
- [ ] `test`: Unit or integration test addition
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance or dependency upgrade

## Verification
- [ ] `make lint` passes (ruff + mypy)
- [ ] `make test` passes (coverage >= 85%)
- [ ] Docker build and local smoke test verified
- [ ] Helm chart linted and tested

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's code style and standards.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix or feature works.
- [ ] No secrets or large model weights are committed.
